data.text/markdown:
SD1.5 VAE Posterior Analysis

This notebook compares the original Stable Diffusion 1.5 VAE posterior against finetuned VAE checkpoints. It focuses on whether the latent posterior remains suitable for downstream latent Flow Matching training: posterior drift, variance collapse, Gaussianity, covariance structure, reconstruction quality, random prior decoding, and interpolation smoothness. The defaults target the v18_sd15_vae_x8_256_minmax run. All paths and analysis limits are editable below.
